FX-CURVES-001.says: All four curves the default, [[0, 0], [255, 255]]: the drawing, untouched.

FX-CURVES-002.says: Master through [[0, 0], [128, 180], [255, 255]]: every colour is lightened, the middle greys most; black and white stay, and so do the empty pixels.

FX-CURVES-003.says: Red alone through an S, [[0, 0], [64, 40], [192, 215], [255, 255]]: only the red channel moves, darker below the middle and lighter above; green and blue stay exactly as drawn.

FX-CURVES-004.says: Master through [[64, 32], [192, 224]]: flat outside its end points, so the ramp's greys at or below 64 all become 32 and those at or above 192 all become 224; between, the straight line.

FX-CURVES-005.says: Master through [[0, 0], [64, 255], [128, 255], [255, 0]]: the spline rises above 255 between 64 and 128 and is held at 255 there.

FX-CURVES-006.says: Master through 16 points, the most allowed, alternating 0 and 255 every 17: the ramp's greys land wherever the zigzag puts them; its 16 swings past 255 and its 240 below 0, each held.

FX-CURVES-007.says: Red through [[0, 0], [255, 128]], halving it, and master through [[0, 0], [128, 255]], doubling: the channel's own curve runs first, so red comes back as drawn while green and blue double, held at 255.

FX-CURVES-008.says: Master through [[0, 255], [255, 0]], inverting: every colour that shows is inverted at its own covering, the soft pixels still soft; the empty pixels stay empty, not white.

FX-CURVES-009.says: Green alone through [[0, 0], [255, 128]]: only green is halved.

FX-CURVES-010.says: Blue alone through [[0, 64], [255, 255]]: only blue is lifted, black's blue to 64.

FX-CURVES-011.says: All four at once: master FX-CURVES-002's lift, red the S, green halved, blue inverted.

FX-CURVES-012.says: Master through three points on the straight line, [[0, 0], [128, 128], [255, 255]]: not the default as written, so it is worked, but the spline through them is the line, so the drawing.

FX-CURVES-013.says: Master through [[0, 0], [127.5, 200.25], [255, 255]], points written with fractions: a lift a little stronger than FX-CURVES-002's.

FX-CURVES-014.says: FX-CURVES-011 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-CURVES-015.says: Master of one point, [[128, 128]], fewer than two. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CURVES-016.says: Red of 17 points, more than sixteen. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CURVES-017.says: Green with an out of 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CURVES-018.says: Blue with an in of -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CURVES-019.says: Master with two points at in 128, so in does not strictly increase. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CURVES-020.says: Master with a point of three numbers, [128, 128, 128]. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
